description: Every chat, embedding, rerank and transcription model on UplinkSwitch with its id, type, the routes and tools that take it, our price (per million tokens, or per audio minute for transcription), the developer's list price where recorded, the wire formats it answers (openai, anthropic, gemini) and its specs. Image, video, speech, music and 3D models are in list_media_models. No key needed. Live from GET /v1/catalog.

developer.description: Only models from this developer (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek...).

search.description: A substring of the model id or name (opus, deepseek, uncensored...).

type.description: Only models of this type. Default: every text model.

name: list_models
title: List every text model and price
